verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              कुरुक्षेत्रं ततो दृष्ट्वा दत्त्वा दायांश्च सात्वतः। आश्रमं सुमहद्दिव्यमगमज्जनमेजय॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said "Having visited Kurukshetra and distributed wealth there the Satwata hero then proceeded, O Janamejaya, to a large and exceedingly beautiful hermitage.

verses.sanskrit: मधूकाम्रवणोपेतं प्लक्षन्यग्रोधसङ्कुलम्। चिरबिल्वयुतं पुण्यं पनसार्जुनसङ्कुलम्॥२॥
verses.english: That hermitage was overgrown with Madhuka and mango trees, and abounded with Plakshas and Nyagrodhas. And it contained many Vilvas and many excellent jack and Arjuna trees.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा यादवश्रेष्ठः प्रवरं पुण्यलक्षणम्। पप्रच्छ तानृषीन्सर्वान्कस्याश्रमवरस्त्वयम्॥३॥
verses.english: Seeing that beautiful hermitage Baladeva asked the Rishis as to whom it belonged.

verses.sanskrit: ते तु सर्वे महात्मानमूचु राजन् हालयुधम्। शृणु विस्तरशो राम यस्यायं पूर्वमाश्रमः॥४॥
verses.english: Those great ones, O king, said Baladeva 'Listen in full, O Rama, as to whose asylum this was formerly.

verses.sanskrit: अत्र विष्णुः पुरा देवस्तप्तवांस्तप उत्तमम्। अत्रास्य विधिवद्यज्ञाः सर्वे वृत्ताः सनातनाः॥५॥
verses.english: Here the god Vishnu formerly practised austere penances. Here he celebrated duly all the eternal sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: अत्रैव ब्राह्मणी सिद्धा कौमारब्रह्मचारिणी। योगयुक्ता दिवं याता तपःसिद्धा तपस्विनी॥६॥
verses.english: Here leading from youth the vow of Brahmacharya, a Brahmani inaiden, was crowned with ascetic success. Ultimately possessed of Yoga powers that ascetic lady went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: बभूव श्रीमती राजञ्शाण्डिल्यस्य महात्मनः। सुता धृतव्रता साध्वी नियता ब्रह्मचारिणी॥७॥
सा तु तप्त्वा तपो घोरं दुश्चरं स्त्रीजनेन ह। गता स्वर्गं महाभागा देब्राह्मणपूजिता॥८॥
verses.english: Having practised the hardest of penances such as the incapable of being performed by women, the blessed lady at last went to heaven, adored by the gods and Brahmanas. Having heard these words of the Rishis, Baladeva entered that hermitage.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा ऋषीणां वचनमाश्रमं तं जगाम ह। ऋषींस्तानभिवाद्याथ पार्श्वे हिमवतोऽच्युतः॥९॥
verses.english: Bidding a farewell to the Rishis, Baladeva performed all the rites and ceremonies of the evening on the side of Himavat and then began to ascend mountain.

verses.sanskrit: सन्ध्याकार्याणि सर्वाणि निर्वर्त्यारुरुहेऽचलम्। नातिदूरं ततो गत्वा नगं तालध्वजो बली॥१०॥
verses.english: The powerful Valarama having the emblem of the palmyra of his banner had not ascended far when he saw a sacred and goodly Tirtha and was stricken with wonder at the sight.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यं तीर्थवरं दृष्ट्वा विस्मयं परमं गतः। प्रभावं च सरस्वत्याः प्लक्षप्रस्रवणं बलः॥११॥
सम्प्राप्तः कारपवनं प्रवरं तीर्थमुत्तमम्। हलायुधस्तत्र चापि दत्त्वा दानं महाबलः॥१२॥
verses.english: Sceing the glory of the Sarasvati as also the Tirtha called Plakshaprasaravana, Vala next reached another excellent and foremost of Tirthas called Karavapana.

verses.sanskrit: आप्लुतः सलिले पुण्ये सुशीते विमले शुचौ। सन्तर्पयामास पितॄन् देवांश्च रणदुर्मदः॥१३॥
verses.english: Having made many presents there, the powerful Baladeva bathed in the cool, clear, sacred, and sin-cleansing water (of that Tirtha).

verses.sanskrit: तत्रोष्यैकां तु रजनीं यतिभिर्ब्राह्मणैः सह। मित्रावरुणयोः पुण्यं जगामाश्रममच्युतः॥१४॥
इन्द्रोऽग्निरर्यमा चैव यत्र प्राक् प्रीतिमाप्नुवन्। तं देशं कारपवनाद्यमुनायां जगाम ह॥१५॥
verses.english: From Karavapana he proceeded to that spot on the Yamuna where formerly Indra and Agni and Aryaman had obtained great felicity.

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा तत्र च धर्मात्मा परां प्रीतिमवाप्य च। ऋषिभिश्चैव सिद्धैश्च सहितो वै महाबलः॥१६॥
verses.english: Bathing there, that Yadu's chief of pious soul, obtained great happiness. The hero then sat himself down with the Rishis and the Siddhas there for listening to their excellent discourses.

verses.sanskrit: उपविष्टः कथाः शुभ्राः शुश्राव यदुपुङ्गवः। तथा तु तिष्ठतां तेषां नारदो भगवानृषिः॥१७॥
आजगामाथ तं देशं यत्र रामो व्यवस्थितः। जटामण्डलसंवीतः स्वर्णचीरो महातपाः॥१८॥
verses.english: There where Rama sat in the midst of that assemblage the adorable Rishi Narada came while trembling.

verses.sanskrit: हेमदण्डधरो राजन् कमण्डलुधरस्तथा। कच्छपीं सुखशब्दां तां गृह्य वीणां मनोरमाम्॥१९॥
verses.english: Wearing matted locks and shining like gold, he carried in his hands, O king, a golden stalf and a waterpot.

verses.sanskrit: नृत्ये गीते च कुशलो देवब्राह्मणपूजितः। प्रकर्ता कलहानां च नित्यं च कलहप्रियः॥२०॥
verses.english: Accomplishment in song and dance and worshipped of gods and Brahmanas, he had with him a beautiful Vina of sweet notes, made of the tortoise-shell.

verses.sanskrit: तं देशमदमद्यत्र श्रीमान् रामो व्यवस्थितः। प्रत्युत्थाय च तं सम्यक् पूजयित्वा यतव्रतम्॥२१॥
verses.english: A creator of quarrels and ever fond of quarrel, the celestial Rishi came where the handsome Rama was resting.

verses.sanskrit: देवर्षिं पर्यपृच्छत्स यथा वृत्तं कुरून्प्रति। ततोऽस्याकथयद्राजन् नारदः सर्वधर्मवित्॥२२॥
verses.english: Standing up and greatly honoring the celestial Rishis if restricted vows, Rama asked him about all that had befallen the Kurus.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वमेतद्यथावृत्तमतीव कुरुसंक्षयम्। ततोऽब्रवीद्रौहिणेयो नारदं दीनया गिरा॥२३॥
verses.english: Conversant with duty and practices, Narada, then, O king, told him everything, as it had occurred, about the dreadful destruction of the Kurus.

verses.sanskrit: किमवस्थं तु तत्क्षत्रं ये तु तत्राभवन्नृपाः। श्रुतमेतन्मया पूर्वं सर्वमेव तपोधन॥२४॥
verses.english: The Rohini's son then, in sorrowful words, enquired of the Rishi, saying-'What is the state of the field? How are those kings now that had assembled there?

verses.sanskrit:
विस्तरश्रवणे जातं कौतूहलमतीव मे।
              नारद उवाच।
              पूर्वमेव हतो भीष्मो द्रोणः सिन्धुपतिस्तथा॥२५॥
verses.english: I have heard everything before, O Rishi, but iny curiosity is great for hearing it in detail!'

verses.sanskrit: हतो वैकर्तनः कर्णः पुत्राश्चास्य महारथाः। भूरिश्रवा रौहिणेय मद्रराजश्च वीर्यवान्॥२६॥
verses.english: Narada said Already Bhishma and Drona and the lord of the Sindhus have died! Vikartana's son Karna also has been killed, with his sons.

verses.sanskrit: एते चान्ये च बहवस्तत्र तत्र महाबलाः। प्रियान्प्राणान्परित्यज्य जयार्थं कौरवस्य वै॥२७॥
verses.english: Bhurishravas too, O son of Rohini, and the brave chief of the Madras have died! These and many other great heroes that had assembled there, rcady to sacrifice this dear life itself for the victory of Duryodhana—have all fallen!

verses.sanskrit: राजानो राजपुत्राश्च समरेष्वनिवर्तिनः। अहतांस्तु महाबाहो शृणु मे तत्र माधव॥२८॥
धार्तराष्ट्रबले शेषास्त्रयः समितिमर्दनाः। कृपश्च कृतवर्मा च द्रोणपुत्रश्च वीर्यवान्॥२९॥
verses.english: Listen now to me, O Madhava, about those that yet alive! In the army of Dhritarashtra's son, only three yet survive.

verses.sanskrit: तेऽपि वै विद्रुता राम दिशो दश भयात्तदा। दुर्योधने हते शल्ये विद्रुतेषु कृपादिषु॥३०॥
verses.english: They are Kripa and Kritavarman and the powerful son of Drona! These also, O Rama, have from fear fled away on all sides!

verses.sanskrit: ह्रदं द्वैपायनं नाम विवेश भृशदुःखितः। शयानं धार्तराष्ट्रं तु सलिले स्तम्भिते तदा॥३१॥
verses.english: After Shalya's fall and the fight of Kripa and the others, Duryodhana, in great sorrow had entered the Dvaipayana lake.

verses.sanskrit: पाण्डवाः सह कृष्णेन वाग्भिरुग्राभिरार्दयन्। स तुद्यमानो बलवान् वाग्मी रामसमन्ततः॥३२॥
verses.english: While resting at the bottom of the lake after solidifying its waters, Duryodhana approached by the Pandavas with Krishna and cut to the quick by their cruel words. are was

verses.sanskrit: उत्थितः स ह्रदाद्वीरः प्रगृह्य महतीं गदाम्। स चाप्युपगतो योद्धं भीमेन सह साम्प्रतम्॥३३॥
verses.english: He has come forward for fighting Bhima for the present. The terrible encounter, O Rama, will take place today!

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यति तयोरद्य युद्धं राम सुदारुणम्। यदि कौतूहलं तेऽस्ति व्रज माधव मा चिरम्। पश्य युद्धं महाघोरं शिष्ययोर्यदि मन्यसे॥३४॥
verses.english: If you feel any curiosity, then hasten O Madhava, without delay! Go, if you like and witness that terrible battle between your two disciples!'

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा तानभ्यर्च्य द्विजर्षभान्। सर्वान्विसर्जयामास ये तेनाभ्यागताः सह॥३५॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said "Hearing Narada, Rama bade a respectful farewell to those great Brahmanas and sent away all those that had accompanied him (in। his pilgrimage).

verses.sanskrit: गम्यतां द्वारकां चेति सोऽन्वशादनुयायिनः। सोऽवतीर्याचलश्रेष्ठात् प्लक्षप्रस्रवणाच्छुभात्॥३६॥
verses.english: He ordered his attendant saying-Return you to Dwaraka!' He then got down from that prince of mountains and that fair hermitage called Plakshaprashravana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रीतमना रामः श्रुत्वा तीर्थफलं महत्। विप्राणां संनिधौ श्लोकमगायदिममच्युतः॥३७॥
verses.english: Having listened to the discourse of the sages about the great merits of Tirthas, Rama sang this verse in the midst of the Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: सरस्वतीवाससमा कुतो रतिः सरस्वतीवाससमाः कुतो गुणाः। सरस्वतीं प्राप्य दिवं गता जनाः सदा स्मरिष्यन्ति नदीं सरस्वतीम्॥३८॥
verses.english: Where is such happiness as is obtainable by living by the Sarasvati? Where else such merits as those obtainable by living by the Sarasvati? Men have departed for heaven, having approached the Sarasvati! All should ever remember the Sarasvati! Sarasvati is the most sacred of all rivers.

verses.sanskrit: सरस्वती सर्वनदीषु पुण्या सरस्वती लोकशुभावहा सदा। सरस्वतीं प्राप्य जनाः सुदुष्कृतं सदा न शोचन्ति परत्र चेह च॥३९॥
verses.english: Sarasvati always confers the greatest happiness on men! After approaching the Sarasvati, men will not have to give for their sins either here or hereafter!'

verses.sanskrit: ततो मुहुर्मुहुः प्रीत्या प्रेक्षमाणः सरस्वतीम्। हयैर्युक्तं रथं शुभ्रमातिष्ठत परन्तपः॥४०॥
verses.english: Repeatedly looking with joy at the Sarasvati, that destroyer of foes then ascended an excellent car to which were yoked beautiful horses.

verses.sanskrit: स शीघ्रगामिना तेन रथेन यदुपुङ्गवः। दिदृक्षुरभिसम्प्राप्तः शिष्ययुद्धमुपस्थितम्॥४१॥
verses.english: Journeying then on that highly fleet car Baladeva, that best of Yadu's race, desirous of seeing the approaching encounter of his two disciples, arrived on the field.”
